workItem: Expose the existing bounded GitHub Enterprise Actions settings reader through the Finance Render runtime as an owner-only, cached, read-only projection independent of ChatGPT Work/Codex execution limits.
workItemDE: Den bestehenden begrenzten GitHub-Enterprise-Actions-Settings-Reader über die Finance-Render-Runtime als Owner-only, gecachte Read-only-Projektion bereitstellen, unabhängig von ChatGPT-Work-/Codex-Ausführungslimits.
scopeBoundary: Reuse scripts/operations/githubEnterpriseSettingsReadClient.mjs; do not create a second GitHub Enterprise transport or settings authority.
GET-only Enterprise Actions policy evidence; no provider mutation and no generic REST proxy.
Owner-only Finance runtime surface protected by the existing checkAdminAccess IAM boundary.
The Enterprise PAT remains server-side only and is never returned, logged, committed or exposed to frontend/model context.
No ChatGPT Work, Codex or chat execution is required for the provider read after deployment.
exitEvidence: Fresh CURRENT_MAIN is an ancestor of the exact branch head.
Focused tests prove canonical-reader reuse, owner-only route wiring, cache behavior and token non-projection.
Render manifest declares only the secret key name with sync:false and the Enterprise slug, never a credential value.
No writer/file/semantic overlap remains before PR creation.
releaseCondition: Release on Human/CODEOWNER merge, PR close, supersession or abandonment.
